outcome: Differentially methylated genes and pathways in GDM placentas
Correlation of placental methylation with fetal growth and cord blood metabolic health biomarkers
cohort: 30 pairs of term placentas from GDM and euglycemic pregnancies matched by infant sex and gestational age at delivery in the Shanghai Birth Cohort
finding: While GDM was associated with changes in DNA methylation of numerous placental genes, these methylation changes did not correlate with measured metabolic health biomarkers in cord blood.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was adjusted for in the analysis.
birth_weight: DMPs in 11 genes were correlated with birth weight z-score.
